statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. CME Globex is in its scheduled 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance break, so no fresh NQ price path is observable. The cash session had meaningful two-way trade despite a strong technology-led close, keeping Tail below WATCH while Stress remains elevated.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the 22:00 UTC futures reopen is the nearest conditional checkpoint, while Friday's 13:15-14:00 UTC data and cash-open cluster is the next concentrated risk window.
headline: Scheduled NQ maintenance break lowers Tail after a strong but two-way technology rally
body: The Nasdaq Composite closed 1.69% higher with technology and semiconductors leading, while Treasury yields and oil eased. Fresh Finviz breadth confirms broad participation, but it is not live NQ structure. With CME Globex in its scheduled maintenance break and earlier meaningful retracement already observed, a persistent no-retracement path is not established.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated during the prior FOMC sequence, fell overnight, rebuilt into Thursday’s U.S. rally, briefly crossed the block threshold during two intraday windows, and returned to WATCH into the cash close. The current maintenance break removes live NQ path evidence rather than confirming continuation.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because CME Globex is closed for scheduled maintenance and Thursday's strong rally still showed meaningful two-way price discovery. The 22:00 UTC reopen is a conditional WATCH checkpoint; the larger risk concentration is Friday's 13:15 industrial-production release, 13:30 cash open/Bowman speech and 14:00 labor-state data.

forecast.analysis: Observed by cutoff: CME Globex is in its scheduled 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance break, so no live NQ path is observable. Thursday's cash session closed sharply higher but included meaningful two-way trade; fresh breadth confirms broad technology strength without proving post-close continuation.
drivers: Fresh Finviz breadth is confirmation only

forecast.analysis: At the 18:00 ET futures reopen, Tail rises to WATCH only conditionally: a gap that holds near the highs with shallow pullbacks would matter, while balanced reopening trade would keep the path below the block threshold.
If the first reopened futures hour develops normal pullbacks and two-sided rotation, Tail falls back below WATCH. A renewed extension with weak mean reversion would invalidate that baseline.
Late-evening risk stays low if futures continue to rotate around prior value. A fresh energy or geopolitical discontinuity would be the main route to a sharper directional repricing.
At the Asia handoff, low Tail assumes no fresh gap and normal retracement behavior. A directional gap that holds with shallow pullbacks would raise the conditional path.
Early Asia remains low-Tail if price discovery stays two-sided. Persistent extension accompanied by aligned yields or energy pressure would weaken that assumption.
Asian-session Tail remains low while meaningful pullbacks persist. Repeated extension after failed retracements would move this hour toward WATCH.
Overnight risk stays contained if futures remain balanced and cross-assets stabilize. A new catalyst that produces one-way price discovery would lift conditional Tail.
Ahead of Europe, Tail edges up slightly because a new regional handoff can expose gaps. The baseline still requires balanced trade unless shallow-pullback continuation appears.
At the European open, Tail remains below WATCH if the U.S. rally is digested through rotation rather than extension. Strong index breadth alone is not proof of a no-retracement path.
Early European trade keeps Tail low if NQ retraces normally and yields remain orderly. A synchronized technology bid with failed pullbacks would raise the next-hour risk path.
Mid-European hours carry modestly higher Tail if the overnight range becomes directional. Continued two-sided movement would keep the regime below WATCH.
As U.S. premarket liquidity builds, Tail stays just below WATCH unless price begins holding near an extreme with shallow pullbacks. Event importance by itself primarily raises Stress.
Late European trade keeps Tail below WATCH if premarket structure remains balanced. A growing gap plus aligned semiconductors and yields would raise conditional concern.
U.S. premarket risk reaches WATCH territory as Friday's data/open cluster approaches, but the forecast remains conditional on any observed gap, pullback depth and cross-asset alignment.
One hour before the main data/open cluster, Stress rises sharply. Tail remains WATCH unless premarket structure becomes persistently directional with failed retracements.

Industrial Production at 13:15 UTC, the 13:30 cash open and Bowman speech create a concentrated checkpoint. Tail stays upper WATCH before observation; escalation requires actual one-way extension or failed pullbacks.
drivers: 13:30 UTC cash open and Bowman speech
Observed pullback depth after the cluster

forecast.analysis: The 14:00 UTC state-employment release follows the opening-auction sequence. Tail remains upper WATCH conditionally if the open holds an extreme with shallow retracements; orderly two-way discovery would lower it.
After the opening cluster, Tail should ease if retracements deepen and volatility decays. A second directional leg with failed pullbacks would keep risk elevated instead.
Mid-morning U.S. risk moderates if price discovery becomes two-sided. Persistent semiconductor-led extension near session extremes would keep Tail nearer WATCH.
Late morning Tail continues to ease under normal mean reversion. A fresh geopolitical or energy shock remains an external route to renewed directional stress.
Early afternoon Tail sits at the WATCH boundary only if the session retains directional efficiency; otherwise normal rotation would move it lower.

Power-hour Tail rises conditionally because late-session continuation can reappear after a strong trend day. Session-high retention plus shallow pullbacks would be the key evidence; absent that, risk remains below the block threshold.
Into the cash close, Tail falls toward the WATCH boundary if price discovery remains orderly. A late one-way extension without retracement would keep the handoff risk higher.

forecastDetail.comment: CME maintenance removes live NQ price-path evidence; the strong cash close was still two-way, keeping Tail low.
The futures reopen is a conditional WATCH checkpoint: a held gap with shallow pullbacks matters more than the prior daily gain.
Normal pullbacks after reopening would return Tail below WATCH; repeated extension after failed retracements would reverse that view.
Balanced late-evening trade keeps Tail low, with energy or geopolitical discontinuity the main external escalation route.
The Asia handoff remains low-Tail absent a held directional gap or unusually weak retracement behavior.
Early Asia stays low-Tail if futures rotate normally; aligned directional extension would weaken that baseline.
